Bog Lurker

A sinewy newt the colour of the peat it lurks in.

Hit Dice: 3 + 1

Armor Class: 6 [13]

Attacks: Bite (1d6)

Saving Throw: 14

Special: Camouflage, Paralysing slime

Movement: 9 (swimming 12)

Alignment: Neutral

Challenge Level/XP: 5/240

Abilities
CamouflageIn the bog the lurker is noticed only on a 1 on 1d6.
Paralysing slimeAnyone bitten who fails the saving throw is paralysed for 1d4 rounds.
